thought.text: App is serving the login page. Let me verify the default credentials actually work via the API.

reasoning_content:
Zammad is responding with HTTP 200 and the login page. Let me verify authentication works with the default credentials via the API. Let me test a login.

Let me test the API to verify credentials admin@example.com / test work.

action.command:
cd /workspace
# Get CSRF token and try signin via the API
curl -s -c /tmp/cookies.txt --max-time 30 http://127.0.0.1:3000/ -o /dev/null
CSRF=$(curl -s -b /tmp/cookies.txt -c /tmp/cookies.txt --max-time 30 http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | grep -oE 'csrf-token" content="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*content="//;s/"//')
echo "CSRF=$CSRF"
curl -s -b /tmp/cookies.txt -c /tmp/cookies.txt --max-time 30 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/signin \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-CSRF-Token: $CSRF" \
  -d '{"username":"admin@example.com","password":"test"}' -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" | tail -10
